Heartseeker.description: Adds 4 additional dice that add their damage to physical damage. Damage is increased by 1 for each success and 4 for each critical.

Recharge.description: Restores {mana} points of mana. This can be used to charge items or as an attack against creatures already saturated with magic.

Ward.description: Target gains {temp_hp} temporary hit points, and any bleeding is reduced based upon spell tier and success roll. Can resuscitate dying characters if cast within {resuscitate_timer} rounds.

Cure.description: Cure target for {major_damage} points of major damage, {moderate_damage} points of moderate damage, and {minor_damage} points of minor damage. Any bleeding is reduced based upon spell tier and success roll.

Benign Transposition.description: Two target creatures, of which you can be one, instantly swap positions. Both subjects must be within range. Objects carried by the creatures (up to the creatures' maximum loads) go with them, but other creatures do not, even if they are carried. The movement is instantaneous and does not provoke attacks of opportunity.

Grease.description: One creature or 10 foot square becomes covered in grease. Covered creatures suffer a -2 situational penalty on athletics checks and gain a +2 situational bonus on escape artist checks. Creatures in the area when the spell is cast, ending their turn in grease, or moving through grease must save or fall prone.

Disguise Self.description: You make yourself – including clothing, armor, weapons, and equipment – look different. You can seem 1 foot shorter or taller, thin, fat, or in between. You cannot change your creature type (although you can appear as another subtype). Otherwise, the extent of the apparent change is up to you. You could add or obscure a minor feature or look like an entirely different person or gender.

Expeditious Retreat.description: This spell increases your base land speed by 30 feet. This adjustment is treated as an enhancement bonus. There is no effect on other modes of movement, such as burrow, climb, fly, or swim. As with any effect that increases your speed, this spell affects your jumping distance (see the Acrobatics skill).

Darkness.description: This spell causes an object to radiate darkness out to a 20-foot radius. This darkness causes the illumination level in the area to drop one step, from bright light to normal light, from normal light to dim light, or from dim light to darkness. This spell has no effect in an area that is already dark. Creatures with light vulnerability or sensitivity take no penalties in normal light. All creatures gain concealment in dim light. All creatures gain total concealment in darkness. Creatures with darkvision can see in an area of dim light or darkness without penalty. Nonmagical sources of light, such as torches and lanterns, do not increase the light level in an area of darkness. Magical light sources only increase the light level in an area if they are of a higher spell level than darkness. If darkness is cast on a small object that is then placed inside or under a lightproof covering, the spell’s effect is blocked until the covering is removed.

Invisibility.description: The creature or object touched radiates an aura of unimportance preventing other creatures from noticing it or them. If any creature realizes, or suspects, the target creature or object are nearby then they can make a wisdom save as a main action to overcome the spell for it's duration. There is a penalty on this save if they do not know which square the creature or object is in, and a cumulative penalty for every failed save. If an attack is made by the target including any harmful spells cast then all creatures within sight of the target immediatly gain the benefit of a successful save. Indirect actions, such as cutting a rope bridge, or setting fire to a building do not grant an automatic save. This spell affects any objects carried by the target when the spell is cast but not objects dropped or picked up after. Any part of an item that the subject carries but that extends more than 10 feet from can be observed. This spell does not prevent creatures from noticing sounds or smells or other nonvisual clues to the targets existance.

Web.description: Web creates a many-layered mass of strong, sticky strands. These strands trap those caught in them. The strands are similar to spiderwebs but far larger and tougher. These masses must be anchored to two or more solid and diametrically opposed points or else the web collapses upon itself and disappears. Creatures caught within a web become grappled by the sticky fibers. Attacking a creature in a web doesn’t cause you to become grappled. Anyone in the effect’s area when the spell is cast must make a Reflex save. If this save succeeds, the creature is inside the web but is otherwise unaffected. If the save fails, the creature gains the grappled condition, but can break free by making a combat maneuver check or Escape Artist check as a standard action against the DC of this spell. The entire area of the web is considered difficult terrain. Anyone moving through the webs must make a combat maneuver check or Escape Artist check as part of their move action, with a DC equal to the spell’s DC. Creatures that fail lose their movement and become grappled in the first square of webbing that they enter. If you have at least 5 feet of web between you and an opponent, it provides cover. If you have at least 20 feet of web between you, it provides total cover. The strands of a web spell are flammable. A flaming weapon can slash them away as easily as a hand brushes away cobwebs. Any fire can set the webs alight and burn away one 5-foot square in 1 round. All creatures within flaming webs take fire damage from the flames.

Disguise Other.description: You make the target creature – including clothing, armor, weapons, and equipment – look different. They can seem 1 foot shorter or taller, thin, fat, or in between. You cannot change your creature type (although you can appear as another subtype). Otherwise, the extent of the apparent change is up to you. You could add or obscure a minor feature or look like an entirely different person or gender.

Create Pit.description: You create a 10-foot-by-10-foot extra-dimensional hole with a depth of 10 feet per two caster ranks (maximum 30 feet). You must create the pit on a horizontal surface of sufficient size. Since it extends into another dimension, the pit has no weight and does not otherwise displace the original underlying material. You can create the pit in the deck of a ship as easily as in a dungeon floor or the ground of a forest. Any creature standing in the area where you first conjured the pit must make a Reflex saving throw to jump to safety in the nearest open space. In addition, the edges of the pit are sloped, and any creature ending its turn on a square adjacent to the pit must make a Reflex saving throw with a +1 bonus to avoid falling into it. Creatures subjected to an effect intended to push them into the pit (such as bull rush) do not get a saving throw to avoid falling in if they are affected by the pushing effect. Creatures who fall into the pit take falling damage as normal. The pit’s coarse stone walls increase the Athletic check difficulty by 2. When the duration of the spell ends, creatures within the hole rise up with the bottom of the pit until they are standing on the surface over the course of a single round.

Silence.description: Upon the casting of this spell, complete silence prevails in the affected area. All sound is stopped: Conversation is impossible, spells with verbal components cannot be cast, and no noise whatsoever issues from, enters, or passes through the area. The spell can be cast on a point in space, but the effect is stationary unless cast on a mobile object. The spell can be centered on a creature, and the effect then radiates from the creature and moves as it moves. An unwilling creature can attempt a Will save to negate the spell and can use Spell Resistance, if any. Items in a creature’s possession or magic items that emit sound receive the benefits of saves and Spell Resistance, but unattended objects and points in space do not. Creatures in an area of a silence spell are immune to sonic or language-based attacks, spells, and effects.

Spiritual Weapon.description: A weapon made of force appears and attacks foes at a distance, as you direct it, dealing force damage. The weapon takes the shape of a weapon favored by your deity or a weapon with some spiritual significance or symbolism to you and has the same properties as a real weapon of its form. It strikes the opponent you designate, starting with one attack in the round the spell is cast and continuing each round thereafter on your turn. It uses the casting bonus and number of dice used to cast the spell for it's attacks.  As a force effect, it can strike incorporeal creatures without the reduction in damage associated with incorporeality. The weapon always strikes from your direction. If the weapon goes beyond the spell range, if it goes out of your sight, or if you are not directing it, the weapon returns to you and hovers. Each round after the first, you can use a main action to redirect the weapon to a new target. If you do not, the weapon continues to attack the previous round’s target. The weapon gains one attack per round. Even if the spiritual weapon is a ranged weapon, use the spell’s range, not the weapon’s normal range, and switching targets still is a main action.

abilities.bardic_inspiration: During your magical performance you can use your performance to inspire your allies or distract your enemies. This creates a pool of luck that can be spent by you or your team to reroll dice on any check your or they make. Each point must be spent before the initial check is made, and each point will allow a single reroll. Using this ability costs one point of mana and can only be used once per turn. This is a main action that can be used as part of maintaining your performance but only if that action is not used for any other purpose such as casting a spell. You gain one point of luck per success, and each point must be used before your next turn or it is lost. Fumbling grants all failures to the DM to be used for the enemy, or against the players.
abilities.better_lucky_than_good: You may spend 3 mana during any round that you are unable to act such as the surprise round. All attacks against you, including spells, are made with half as many dice with a minimum of 3 dice. Enemies are unconsciously aware of this penalty and may instead choose to target your allies instead or use 3 dice on the attack.
abilities.casting_feat: You may choose any one spellcasting feat
abilities.channel_divinity: You gain a number of abilities from your god and can activate them by spending one point of mana. Using these abilities requires you to be in good standing with your god. You gain Turn Undead, and an additional ability based upon your domain.
abilities.combat_trickery: You gain a number of Arcane Spells listed in the Trickery List as innate spells. You can cast these spells as a main action without needing to memorize or prepare them each day.
abilities.combat_healing: You can prepare a number of healing spells each day allowing you to cast those spells as a main action. Preparing spells requires 1 hour of prayer. Once you have prepared spells for the day you cannot do so again until the next day.
abilities.danger_sense: You can reflexively react to unseen dangers. When taking damage from any source, even when unaware, you can use your reaction to gain +4 luck bonus to your damage resilience against that damage. Costs 4 mana.
abilities.domain: Each deity has a porfolio of domains to offer. You may choose one and gain the powers and spells known from that domain
abilities.fast_movement: Your land speed is increased by 10 feet. This benefit applies only when you are wearing no armor, light armor, or medium armor, and are not carrying a heavy load.
abilities.improved_healing: You can see injuries, afflictions, magical saturation, and the life energy flowing through all creatures including the negative life energy of undead. The range of this ability starts at 10 feet and increases by 5 feet every two levels. All creatures can hide this aura from you and automatically attempt to do so whenever they make a stealth check. This will allow you to make a heal check to identify the details of an affliction affecting a creature within range. This ability does not work if you are blinded.
abilities.jack_of_all_trades: You can learn a magical variant of any performance skill. This skill can be used to make mundane checks, or to create a magical performance. Performing requires a main action each turn to maintain and bardic spells can be cast as part of this action. When multiclassing, this skill is only advanced when taking levels in bard.
abilities.mage_hand_legermain: When you cast Mage Hand, you can make the hand invisible, and you can perform the following additional tasks with it: stow one object the hand is holding in a container worn or carried by another creature, retrieve an object in a container worn or carried by another creature, or use thieves' tools to pick locks and disarm traps at range.
abilities.magical_performance: You can learn a magical variant of any performance skill. This skill can be used to make mundane checks, or to create a magical performance. Performing requires a main action each turn to maintain and bardic spells can be cast as part of this action. When multiclassing, this skill is only advanced when taking levels in bard.
abilities.mindless_rage: You cannot be charmed or frightened while raging. If you enter a rage while charmed or frightened then the effect is suspended for the duration of the rage.
abilities.performance_feat: You gain Familiar, Social Spell, Spell Focus Enchantment, or Spell Focus Illusion as a bonus feat.
abilities.primal_tenacity: You can use your reaction to gain a +4 circumstantial bonus to your damage reduction against a single attack. Costs 4 mana.
abilities.rage: You can spend a point of mana to enter a rage for one minute. At the end of your rage you are exhausted  for 10 minutes. You can enter a rage as a free action but not if you are surprised. While raging you gain the following circumstantial bonuses: one point of damage reduction plus an additional point every 3 levels, and one point of damage resilience, plus an additional point every 2 levels. You also gain a number of rage powers based upon your level. You cannot enter a rage while fatigued or extend your rage unless a power specifically states otherwise.
abilities.reckless_attacks: If you use all of your remaining dice on an attack action you gain an additional number of dice for that attack action equal to your level.
abilities.see_injury: You can see injuries, afflictions, magical saturation, and the life energy flowing through all creatures including the negative life energy of undead. The range of this ability starts at 10 feet and increases by 5 feet every two levels. All creatures can hide this aura from you and automatically attempt to do so whenever they make a stealth check. This will allow you to make a heal check to identify the details of an affliction affecting a creature within range. This ability does not work if you are blinded.
abilities.silver_tongue: You gain a +1 inherent bonus to persuasion and deception checks. This bonus applies when using versatile performance.
abilities.sneak_attack: Your weapon attacks deal +1 damage against flat-footed creatures within 30 feet. This bonus increases by 1 at 3rd level and every 2 levels thereafter. Before rolling, you may impose an additional effect, increasing the attack's success requirement from 2 to 3. The target makes a Constitution save with a penalty equal to your sneak attack bonus to resist additional effects. Effects: increase bleeding by 10 per point of sneak attack damage, decrease target’s movement speed by half till healed. Additional effect options available through feats or subclasses.
abilities.bardic_spellcasting: You gain a number of spells that can be cast as a main action during any round that you are performing. These spells do not need to be prepared each day. Casting when you are not performing takes twice as long.
abilities.thieves_cant: During your rogue training you learned thieves' cant, a secret mix of dialect, jargon, and code that allows you to hide messages in seemingly normal conversation. Only another creature that knows thieves' cant understand such messages. It takes twice as long to convey such a message than it does to speak the same idea plainly.In addition, you understand a set of secret signs and symbols used to convey short, simple messages, such as whether an area is dangerous or the territory of a thieves' guild, whether loot is nearby, or whether the people in an area are easy marks or will provide a safe house for thieves on the run.
abilities.trapfinding: By spending one point of mana you can sense magical auras including the auras of hidden magical traps. Using this requires concentration. At level 5, and every 5 levels afterwards, you gain a +1 competence bonus to perception checks when searching for traps. You do not need to be actively using this ability to gain the competency bonus.
abilities.turn_undead: All undead within 30 feet must make a wisdom saving throw or become panicked.
abilities.uncanny_dodge: You are always considered to be dodging an attack even if you are unaware of it or do not have any dice to spend. You must be capable of moving and some abilities negate this ability. If you gain the rage ability then you can enter a rage even if surprised.
abilities.unsettling_words: You can use points of luck from your performance to affect the checks of your enemies. You must decide to use your luck point before they roll and afterwards you can choose one of their dice to reroll.
abilities.versatile_performance: You can use points of luck from your performance to affect the checks of your enemies. You must decide to use your luck point before they roll and afterwards you can choose one of their dice to reroll.
abilities.bite: Natural bite attack. Deals str/4 damage.
abilities.claws: Natural claw attack. Deals str/4 damage.
abilities.slam: Natural slam attack. Deals str/4 damage.
abilities.natural_armor: Naturally tough hide or skin that reduces all damage taken by 1. Stacks with worn armor.
abilities.staggered: This creature is limited in its actions, halving its combat pool.
abilities.improved_initiative: This creature reacts faster than normal. All initiative dice rolled are increased by 1, to a maximum of 10.
abilities.ferocity: Hit points are increased by 5, and damage resiliance is increased by 3
abilities.ghoul_fever: A creature bitten by a ghoul must make a Constitution save against the ghoul's proficiency bonus or contract ghoul fever. Each day the afflicted creature must make a new save or take 1 point of major damage. A creature that dies from ghoul fever rises as a ghoul at the next midnight.
abilities.ghoul_paralysis: A creature hit by a ghoul's natural attack must make a Constitution save against the ghoul's proficiency bonus or be paralyzed for 1d4+1 rounds. Elves are immune to this effect.
